        envFrom:

        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /hadoop-state
          name: hadoop-nn-volume
        securityContext:

            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
      containers:
      - name: hadoop-namenode
        image: mpolatcan/hadoop:3.2.1-java8
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: hadoop-namenode
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /home/hduser
          name: hadoop-nn-volume
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 9870
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 2
          failureThreshold: 3
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 9870
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 2
          failureThreshold: 3
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN

          runAsNonRoot: true
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
      volumes:
      - name: hadoop-nn-volume
        emptyDir: {}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: meu-deployment
  labels:
    deployment: bolado_deployment
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      example: olx-bolada
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        example: olx-bolada
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: meu-container
        image: ralphavalon/kube_features:v2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8081
        env:
        - name: API_HOST
          value: 192.168.99.100:30934
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: 64Mi
            cpu: 100m
          limits:
            memory: 128Mi
            cpu: 250m
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8081
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8081
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
